entities.summary: The Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization – People's Party, shortened as VMRO – People's Party and VMRO–NP, is a national-conservative political party in North Macedonia, founded by the former Prime Minister Ljubčo Georgievski, who split from the VMRO–DPMNE. The VMRO–NP was founded in Skopje on 4 July 2004. Vesna Janevska was elected as the party's first chairwoman. It is among the smaller parties of the country.
